I will plant improved maize seed because here in Mbeya maize does well when the rains come well, and I have seen farmers near me get better harvest from improved seed when they also put fertilizer. I will use chemical fertilizer, but not too much, because cash is still tight and I must manage this plot with what I can afford this season. I do not plan to irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I will use a herbicide to reduce weeding labor. I will do most of the work with family labor, then hire a few people at planting and weeding time.
